meta.description: Illustrative EU default, not market data: a behind-the-meter PPA paid on the on-site generation the site consumes. Every value sits inside a cited public range (see notes); replace it with your own offer.
notes: not market data: a starting point to replace with your own offer or an organisation pack

range:price=32.5..63.4 EUR/MWh|LevelTen European PPA Price Index Q4 2025, P25 solar, EU markets Spain 32.50 to France 63.40 (reported by pv magazine)|https://www.pv-magazine.com/2026/02/09/solar-wind-ppa-prices-continue-to-fall-in-europe/|2026

range:tenor_years=5..20 years|EIB Advisory, commercial PPA study: a cPPA is a long-term contract 'e.g. of 5-20 years'|https://advisory.eib.org/files/publications/attachments/developing-potential-financial-instruments-and-advisory-solutions-to-stimulate-more-investment-in-renewable-energy-generation-by-means-of-commercial-power-purchase-agreements.pdf|2023
